journal: Monday was brutal. The morning commute was delayed, and my supervisor piled up three new project deadlines out of nowhere. I feel overwhelmed and anxious about this week.
Still feeling the pressure today. Spent 6 hours fixing bugs in production. My head hurts, and I couldn't sleep well tonight thinking about tomorrow's presentation.
Presentation went surprisingly well! The client loved the layout. Had lunch with the team and managed to sign off work on time at 5 PM. Feeling relieved and happier.
A quiet Thursday. Mostly just administrative tasks and answering emails. Energy levels are a bit low, but overall it was a stable and calm day.
Fridays are always chaotic. Another last-minute request came in at 4:30 PM, forcing me to cancel dinner plans with my family. Stressed out again.
Finally Saturday. Slept in until 10 AM. Spent the afternoon reading a book at a local coffee shop. No work notifications at all. Feeling refreshed.
Sunday evening is here and the 'Sunday Scaries' are kicking in. A bit anxious about tomorrow's weekly meeting, but trying to stay positive by relaxing.
